import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/titanic.csv')

# Create a figure with subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 10))
fig.suptitle('Titanic Passenger Survival Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=1.00)

# 1. Survival rate by class and sex
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
survival_by_class_sex = df.groupby(['class', 'sex'])['survived'].mean().unstack()
survival_by_class_sex.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax1, color=['#FF6B6B', '#4ECDC4'], width=0.7)
ax1.set_title('Survival Rate by Class and Sex', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_xlabel('Passenger Class', fontsize=10)
ax1.set_ylabel('Survival Rate', fontsize=10)
ax1.set_xticklabels(ax1.get_xticklabels(), rotation=0)
ax1.legend(title='Sex', loc='upper right')
ax1.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)
ax1.set_ylim(0, 1)

# 2. Age distribution by survival status
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
survived_ages = df[df['survived'] == 1]['age'].dropna()
died_ages = df[df['survived'] == 0]['age'].dropna()
ax2.hist([died_ages, survived_ages], bins=20, label=['Died', 'Survived'], 
         color=['#FF6B6B', '#95E1D3'], alpha=0.7, edgecolor='black')
ax2.set_title('Age Distribution by Survival Status', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_xlabel('Age (years)', fontsize=10)
ax2.set_ylabel('Number of Passengers', fontsize=10)
ax2.legend(loc='upper right')
ax2.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 3. Survival count by embarkation port
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
embark_survival = df.groupby(['embark_town', 'survived']).size().unstack(fill_value=0)
embark_survival.plot(kind='bar', stacked=True, ax=ax3, color=['#FF6B6B', '#95E1D3'], width=0.6)
ax3.set_title('Passenger Count by Embarkation Port and Survival', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_xlabel('Embarkation Port', fontsize=10)
ax3.set_ylabel('Number of Passengers', fontsize=10)
ax3.set_xticklabels(ax3.get_xticklabels(), rotation=45, ha='right')
ax3.legend(['Died', 'Survived'], title='Status', loc='upper right')
ax3.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 4. Fare distribution by class and survival
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
for i, pclass in enumerate(['First', 'Second', 'Third']):
    survived_fare = df[(df['class'] == pclass) & (df['survived'] == 1)]['fare']
    died_fare = df[(df['class'] == pclass) & (df['survived'] == 0)]['fare']
    
    positions = [i*3, i*3+1]
    bp = ax4.boxplot([died_fare, survived_fare], positions=positions, widths=0.6,
                      patch_artist=True, showfliers=False,
                      boxprops=dict(alpha=0.7),
                      medianprops=dict(color='black', linewidth=2))
    
    bp['boxes'][0].set_facecolor('#FF6B6B')
    bp['boxes'][1].set_facecolor('#95E1D3')

ax4.set_title('Fare Distribution by Class and Survival', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_xlabel('Passenger Class', fontsize=10)
ax4.set_ylabel('Fare (£)', fontsize=10)
ax4.set_xticks([0.5, 3.5, 6.5])
ax4.set_xticklabels(['First', 'Second', 'Third'])
ax4.set_ylim(0, 300)
ax4.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# Create custom legend
from matplotlib.patches import Patch
legend_elements = [Patch(facecolor='#FF6B6B', alpha=0.7, label='Died'),
                   Patch(facecolor='#95E1D3', alpha=0.7, label='Survived')]
ax4.legend(handles=legend_elements, loc='upper right')

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
